description: Different model profiles should preserve bounded SDK-style C# project ownership, the exact project command, direct asserted type evidence, and data-model deferral.

lockedFields.reason: One static root SDK test project should retain its exact project-file command.
The checked single-project fixture should remain inside the first bounded ownership contract.
The untested checkout service should remain the one add-test item.
The directly asserted price parser should remain the one extend-test item.
The data-only checkout request should remain deferred.
The branching service should retain its source-owned plan identity.
The parser should remain covered but worthy of edge-case extension.
The exact unique-type call should remain attached to its attributed xUnit test.
The static parser call remains nested inside the xUnit assertion statement.
Data-only records should not become direct test recommendations.
